name: Beginner
title: A1 — Beginner Foundation
description: Essential words, daily greetings, simple present sentences, and basic vocabulary.

name: Elementary
title: A2 — Elementary English
description: Routine communications, past and future simple tenses, shopping, travel.

name: Intermediate
title: B1 — Intermediate Bridge
description: Conditionals, phrasal verbs, workplace conversation, storytelling, fluency.

name: Upper Intermediate
title: B2 — Upper Intermediate
description: Complex debate, idiomatic expressions, professional meetings, interview mastery.

name: Advanced
title: C1 — Advanced Professional
description: Academic English, persuasive presentation, nuanced idioms, high-level writing.

name: Mastery
title: C2 — Native-Level Mastery
description: Near-native precision, subtle humor, literature, boardroom negotiations.
